text: In schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 2xvi cannot be more than Rs. 200000.
In Schedule CYLA, HP Income should be equal to Sl.No. 3 of Schedule HP
Other sources loss at Schedule CYLA should be equal to the amount mentioned in "Schedule OS".
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 2xvi "Total loss set off" should be equal to sum of (2ii + 2iv + 2v + 2vi + 2vii + 2viii + 2ix + 2x+2xi+2xii +2xiii+2xiv+2xv)
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 3xvi "Total loss set off" should be equal to sum of ( 3iii+ 3vii+ 3viii + 3ix + 3x+3xi+3xii +3xiii+3xiv+3xv)
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 4xvi "Total loss set off" should be equal to sum of ( 4ii+ 4iii+4iv++4v+4vi+4vii+ 4viii + 4ix + 4x+4xi+4xii+4xiii+4xv)
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 2xvii i.e. Loss remaining after set-off should be equal to the output of Sl.No. 2i-2xvi
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 3xvii i.e. Loss remaining after set-off should be equal to the output of Sl.No. 3i-3xvi
In Schedule CYLA, Sl.No. 4xvii i.e. Loss remaining after set-off should be equal to the output of Sl.No. 4i-4xvi
In Schedule CYLA, Col No.5 "Current year’s Income remaining after set off" should be equal to the output of Col No. 1-2-3-4
In Schedule CYLA, Income from Business & profession (excluding Income from speculation income and income from specified business) should be equal to Sl.No. A37
in Schedule BP In Schedule CYLA, Speculative Income should be equal to SL.No. 3ii of Table E Schedule BP
In Schedule CYLA, Specified business Income should be equal to Sl.No. 3iii of Table E of Schedule BP 34
In Schedule CYLA, Short term capital gain @30% should be equal to Sl.No. 8iii of item E of Schedule CG
In Schedule CYLA, Short term capital gain taxable at applicable rates should be equal to Sl.No. 8iv of item E of Schedule CG
In Schedule CYLA, Short term capital gain taxable at special rates in India as per DTAA should be equal to Sl.No. 8v of item E of Schedule CG
In Schedule CYLA, Long term capital gain taxable as per DTAA @special rate should be equal to Sl.No. 8vii of item E of Schedule CG
In Schedule CYLA, Other Source Income(excluding profit from owning race horses and amount chargeable to special rate of tax) should be equal to Sl.No. 6 of Schedule OS
In Schedule CYLA, Profit from owning and maintaining race horses should be equal to Sl.No. 8e of Schedule OS
In Schedule CYLA, Income from other sources taxable at special rates in India as per DTAA should be equal to Sl.No. 2f of Schedule OS
In Schedule CYLA, Salary Income should be equal to Sl.No. 6 of Schedule Salary
If "New Tax Regime" is selected, In schedule CYLA, loss under house property cannot be allowed to set off at Sl. No. 2ii to 2xii.
If "New Tax Regime" is selected, In schedule CYLA, loss under head house property cannot be carry forwarded at Sl. No. 2xvii.
In Schedule CYLA, 'Total loss set off' cannot be more than the 'Loss to be set off'
In Schedule CYLA ,Row No (xvii) should be equal to (i - xvi) i.e. Loss to be adjusted - total loss set off (xvi) , for HP, BP and OS and cannot be negative.
In Schedule CYLA, Normal OS loss should be set off first against the (i)Profit from the activity of owning and maintaining race horses & (ii)Income from other sources taxable
at special rates in India as per DTAA In Schedule CYLA, whole House property loss can be setoff against any head of income in case income is more than loss
In Schedule CYLA sum of column no 2 + 3 + 4 should not exceed amount as referred in column 1
In Schedule CYLA, house property losses cannot be adjusted against any income in case new tax regime is opted by taxpayer
In Schedule CYLA, whole business loss can be setoff against any head of income in case income is more than loss
In Schedule CYLA, whole OS loss can be setoff against any head of income in case income is more than loss
In Schedule CYLA, Short term capital gain @20% should be equal to Sl.No. 8ii of item E of Schedule CG 35
In Schedule CYLA, Long term capital gain taxable @12.5% should be equal to Sl.No. 8vi of item E of Schedule CG
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 2(ii) should be equal to Sl.No. 4(xviii) of CFL
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 2(iii+iv+v) should be equal to Sl.No. 5c(xviii)+6(xviii)+7(xviii) of Schedule CFL
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 2(vi +vii+viii+ix+x +xi) should be equal to Sl.No. 8(xviii)+9(xviii) of CFL
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 2xv should be equal to sum of Sl.No.(2ii + 2iii + 2iv + 2v + 2vi+ 2vii +2viii + 2ix + 2x + 2xi + 2xiii)
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. xvi should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (5i + 5ii + 5iii + 5iv+ 5v + 5vi+ 5vii + 5viii + 5ix + 5x + 5xi +5xii + 5xiii+ 5xiv)
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 3xv should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (3ii + 3iii + 3iv + 3v + 3vi+ 3vii +3viii + 3ix + 3x+ 3xi+3xii+3xiii+3xiv )
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 4xv should be equal to sum of Sl.No. (4ii + 4iii + 4iv + 4v + 4vi+ 4vii +4viii + 4ix + 4x+ 4xi+4xii+4xiii+4xiv)
The value claimed as Brought forward allowance under section 35(4) set off in Schedule BFLA should be same as reflecting in Schedule UD
The value claimed as Brought forward depreciation set off in Schedule BFLA should be same as reflecting in Schedule UD
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1i should be equal to Sl.No. 5ii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1ii should be equal to Sl.No. 5iii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1iii should be equal to Sl.No. 5iv of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1iv should be equal to Sl.No. 5v of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1v should be equal to Sl.No. 5vi of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1vii should be equal to Sl.No. 5viii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1viii should be equal to Sl.No. 5ix of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1ix should be equal to Sl.No. 5x of schedule CYLA
